config.title: Merchant Settings
config.isMerchantTooltip: Players can double-click this token to open its shop.
config.shopNameHint: Blank names the shop after whoever runs it.
config.kindHint: Flavour only. Shown above the name in the shop.
config.descriptionHint: Shown to players. Links and inline rolls work.
config.descriptionPlaceholder: A cramped shop that smells of oil and iron filings.
config.tillTooltip: Everything in the till, converted to the coins prices are quoted in
config.tillHint: What this shop can pay out when the party sells to it.
config.hiddenTooltip: Players are never sent this inventory
config.openInventoryTooltip: Open this inventory to stock it
config.productsTooltip: How many different things this inventory carries. A roll table fills it back up to this number.
config.productsLabel: How many different products this inventory carries
config.maxStackLabel: Maximum quantity of any one item
config.depthSummary: Type, rarity and price each set a ceiling, and the lowest wins.
config.depthWorldNote: These are world settings, in Merchant's module settings. Depth scales them for this inventory.
config.purchasedNote: Items bought from this inventory are removed and never restocked. Its stock is whatever the party has sold to the shop.
config.drawLabel: How many items to draw from this table
config.removeTableTooltip: Take this table off the inventory
config.noInventories: No inventories yet. Add one to start stocking this merchant.
config.overriding: Currently overriding the schedule. The next opening or closing hour will set it straight.
config.tillEmpty: An empty till cannot buy anything — the party will be refused when they try to sell.
config.globalMarkupHint: The baseline for everything in this shop. Each inventory multiplies against it.
config.pricingNone: No price until one is agreed with the party on the slate.
config.maxStackTooltipInfinite: The most of any one item a table roll will leave here. This inventory never runs out, so nothing else is capped by it.
config.maxStackTooltipFinite: The most of any one item this inventory will hold — a table roll, and a quantity you type in the shop window.
config.tableAuto: Drawn again every time this inventory restocks.
config.tableManual: Drawn only when you press Restock.
config.restockEverythingTooltip: Bring every inventory back to its quantities and roll all of its tables
config.drawTooltip: How many items to take from this table. {when}
config.queryNote: Drawn from what is installed right now, so it never goes stale and picks up new content on its own. Existing rows are topped up to their quantity first; this only brings in things the shelf does not already carry.
config.queryUnavailable: Stocking from the compendiums needs a newer Coffee Pub Blacksmith. Until then this shelf draws from its roll tables.

market.blurb: What goods are worth on {scene}, whoever is asking. Every merchant here prices against it, and it applies to what they pay as well as what they charge — which is what makes running goods between two places worth doing.

settings.soundSlateAddHint: Played when something is put on the slate, to buy or to sell.
settings.soundSlateUpdateHint: Played when a quantity or a price on the slate is changed.
settings.soundSlateClearHint: Played when a line is taken off the slate, or the whole slate is wiped.
settings.soundTransactionHint: Played when goods and coin change hands.
settings.soundRestockHint: Played to the GM when an inventory or a whole shop finishes restocking.
settings.soundErrorHint: Played when an action is refused or fails.
settings.stockCapTypeHint: The most of one {type} a shop stocks at once, before price and rarity are considered. 0 means no limit from the type.

rate.sellHint: What it then charges for them, on top of the Global Markup.
rate.markupHint: Multiplied against the shop's Global Markup.
